description.en: Free web search with 10 engines (Bing/DuckDuckGo/SearXNG/AnySearch free + Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Perplexity/DeepSeek paid), automatic fallback chain, time-filtered advanced search, platform search (GitHub/Reddit), web page fetching, LRU caching, and a settings UI. No API keys required for basic use.
description.zh: 免费网页搜索：10 个搜索引擎（Bing/DuckDuckGo/SearXNG/AnySearch 免费 + Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Perplexity/DeepSeek 付费），自动故障转移、时间过滤搜索、平台搜索（GitHub/Reddit）、网页抓取、LRU 缓存和设置界面。基础使用无需 API 密钥。
